name: Tampere Workers' Hall
scope: The historic cream-plaster Tampere Workers’ Hall on the corner of Hämeenpuisto and Hallituskatu, including the stepped tower, the lower hall wings and their courtyard.
era: The protected hall as it stands, including the 1930s tower addition and the later changes recorded by the city.

originalReview.notes: The exact 2025 exterior shows the Nootti entrance, both balconies, rounded second-tier openings, upper windows, grooved pilasters and granite plinth along Hämeenpuisto.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the exact cleared Qualla CC0 street photograph and the official survey. The later red theatre is a separate building.
